INSERT INTO local_user_identities (id, user_id, provider, subject, email, created_at)
               VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
               RETURNING id         AS "id!: Uuid",
                         user_id    AS "user_id!: Uuid",
                         provider   AS "provider!",
                         subject    AS "subject!",
                         email      AS "email?",
                         created_at AS "created_at!: DateTime<Utc>"
